verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents a `return_page_markdown` parameter for markdown output and returns raw HTML by default, plus `extract_rules`/`ai_query` for structured JSON extraction — covering several concrete output-format choices. However there is no evidence of a plain-text or frontmatter output option, so the full range of formats named in the story is not confirmed. Missing for 10: dedicated plain-text output mode, frontmatter output mode, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of format switching beyond docs.
